description: Reads the app's sales. "list": each with product, units, amount, status, the buyer's userId and email (personal data), canRefund and the seller who was paid; "documents" { saleId }: the receipt or invoice links Stripe keeps. Changes nothing; neblla_sales refunds. More: neblla_get_llms tools/sales_read

action.description: "list" or "documents". By action: list {status?, productId?, from?, to?, seller?, skip?, limit?}; documents {saleId}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

saleId.description: documents: the sale's id, from list.

seller.description: list: only sales paid to this seller.

name: neblla_sales_read
title: Read sales
